title: Tier-1 interpretation of one capture, format version 0
description: What the clerk read in one capture after the code-side checks: the items it found (capture variant) or the facts of one short document (document variant). The model fills the fields marked model, through the separate model-facing schema; code fills the fields marked code. See docs/spec/capture-event-v0.md section 6.

variant.description: Code, from the capture's source.kind and media.

language.description: The capture's locale; titles are written in this language. Code.

items.description: Capture variant: one entry per separate thing to do, pay, send, wait for or note. May be empty.

unfiled.description: Parts of the capture text that no accepted item covers but that look actionable, or that the model refused. Shown on the review card in the capture's own words. Code.

document.description: Document variant: the facts of one short document.

name.description: The binder chosen by the separate binder call from the names offered, or the binder named by binder_hint. Absent when the answer was not-sure. Model (binder call) or code (hint).

from_hint.description: True when the name came from the capture's binder_hint and the model was not asked. Code.

signals.description: The signals that agree with name. hint: binder_hint names it. binder_call: the model picked it. index_match: a full-text match of the item's sentence in that binder's index. neighbours: the items around it went to the same binder. Empty when there is no name. Code.

confidence_band.description: Computed by code from signals with the fixed table in section 6.4. Never written by the model.

value.description: The amount as a number, parsed by code from text. Code.

currency.description: As spoken or printed, such as dollars or CAD. Code, from text.

text.description: The amount exactly as spoken or printed. It occurs in the item's sentence, or for a document in the text that was read. Model, checked by code.

quote.description: The opening words of the capture sentence this came from, as the model copied them. Model.

anchored.description: True when code found the quote in the capture text. Code.

start.description: Offset of the start of the sentence that holds the quote, in Unicode scalar values. Code.

end.description: Offset just past the end of that sentence. Code.

reason.description: not_covered: no item quotes this sentence, and it holds a time expression, an amount or an action verb. refused, guardrail: the model would not read this window. truncated: the answer for this window was cut off at the response token cap.

candidate.description: The id of one of the open items offered as candidates in this call. Model, through a per-call enum; code checks it.

relation.description: same: nothing new. done: the capture says the item is finished. update: the capture changes it. Model.

title.description: A short title for the item, in the capture's language. Model.

action.description: What has to happen. Not the teka item kind; code maps it (section 6.5). Model.

when_text.description: The time expression exactly as spoken; kept only when it occurs in the quote's sentence and matches a known time pattern. Model. Never a resolved date.

when_role.description: Which teka date when_resolved fills, from the words around when_text (by, until, if not by). Code.

when_resolved.description: The date code resolved when_text to, from captured_at and locale. Never earlier than the capture date. Code.

people.description: People named for this item, as spoken; a role such as the notary is fine. Each entry occurs in the capture text as whole words and is not a pronoun or an indefinite such as someone. Model, checked by code.

speaker.description: Meetings only: the label of the turn that holds the item's sentence. Code.

match.description: Set when a second one-task call found that this item is an open item already in the binder. Absent otherwise.

name.description: As printed; occurs in the text that was read. Model, checked by code.

role.description: sender, recipient, payer, payee, or another short role word. Model.

when_text.description: As printed; occurs in the text that was read. Model, checked by code.

label.description: What the deadline is for. Model.

title.description: A title for the document. Model.

date_text.description: The document's date as printed. Model.

date.description: The document's date, normalized. Code only.

summary.description: One sentence on what the document is. Model.
